name: Monopoly Melts Live Rosin Disposable | Zquirt
description:
Zquirt Cold Cure Live Rosin Disposable Vape

(Blueberry Muffin x Tang #118) Zquirt smacks with an aggressive blast of lemon-lime and orange gas. The rosin? Straight eye candy — white, creamy, and whipped to perfection. Loud, tangy, and ridiculously flavorful, this one hits hard and looks damn good doing it.
